creative_provenance.observation: Reviewed project workshops use annotated working papers to expose assumptions and evidence beside a recommendation.
creative_provenance.design_implication: Use local annotations as a structural evidence device rather than generic decorative numbering.

creative_provenance.observation: The audience needs confidence without prestige theater or visual urgency.
creative_provenance.design_implication: Use controlled contrast, precise typography, and one deliberate interruption instead of ornamental luxury cues.

distinctive_expression.aesthetic_thesis: A working brief whose visible annotations make rigor, uncertainty, and decision progress part of the identity.
subject_world: Annotated working papers, evidence margins, decision exhibits, and workshop synthesis
Executive reading patterns that move between a recommendation and its basis
distinctive_expression.signature_element: A responsive evidence margin that stays attached to the claim it qualifies and becomes an inline reveal on narrow screens.

aesthetic_risk.move: Let the evidence margin interrupt the primary reading column at one consequential moment.
aesthetic_risk.rationale: The interruption makes proof structurally visible instead of treating it as secondary metadata.
aesthetic_risk.boundary: The reading order remains linear, keyboard accessible, and understandable when the margin collapses or motion is reduced.

anti_defaults: Do not use generic numbered editorial sections when order carries no meaning.
Do not rely on warm cream, high-contrast serif, and red accent as a substitute for a project-specific identity.

palette: Signal cobalt — #2855D9 — verified evidence and active navigation
Trace ochre — #C88A24 — provisional or qualified material
typography: Display: a compact grotesk with assertive width for recommendations, used sparingly.
Body: a highly legible serif optimized for sustained reading rather than luxury signaling.
Utility: a tabular mono for provenance, dates, and evidence states.
composition: Use a recommendation column and an attached evidence margin; allow one evidence block to cross the boundary as the signature interruption.
material_imagery: Use cropped working artifacts, diagram fragments, or visibly qualified evidence; avoid generic executive photography.
motion: Use one orchestrated reveal that connects a claim to its evidence; provide an immediate non-motion equivalent.
voice: Write in direct executive language, distinguish observation from inference, and avoid abstract transformation claims.

expression_budget.weight_rationale: The audience benefits from a clearly authored point of view, while sustained executive reading and evidence integrity keep the selected direction below the exploration ceiling.
expression_budget.boundary_being_pushed: Make the evidence margin the one unmistakable structural interruption.
expression_budget.quiet_field: Keep the reading field, type scale, imagery, motion, and surface treatment disciplined around the evidence interruption.
expression_budget.containment_boundary: The margin may interrupt the column once, but must preserve linear reading order, readable measure, and a clear narrow-screen transformation.
removal_order: Simplify the boundary crossing while preserving claim-to-evidence attachment

brand_signature.identity_premise: Rigor becomes visible because every recommendation remains structurally attached to its evidence and uncertainty.

primary_carrier.role: Make claim-to-evidence attachment the recognizable identity behavior.
primary_carrier.rule: Use an attached evidence margin with one bounded crossing at the most consequential proof moment.
primary_carrier.quiet_variant: Use a two-pixel evidence rule, direct status label, and immediate source reference without a boundary crossing.

recurring_carriers.role: Carry identity through routine and dense surfaces.
recurring_carriers.rule: Pair every qualification with a direct label and source state.
Name the decision, evidence, uncertainty, and owner in direct language.

brand_signature.utility_expression: Use compact evidence labels and claim-source adjacency while retaining conventional navigation and controls.
brand_signature.quiet_mode: On approvals, errors, and dense evidence surfaces, remove the crossing and preserve only the attached rule, label, and source.
brand_signature.campaign_mode: Expand the evidence margin into a spatial reasoning line while keeping claims qualified and motion optional.

subject_tokens.role: Connect a claim to its basis.
subject_tokens.visual_rule: Signal cobalt rule; two pixels in utility mode and up to six pixels in campaign mode.
Tabular utility type paired with literal status language.

transformation_matrix.behavior: Use the spatial evidence margin and one boundary-crossing proof moment.
Use compact source-state labels and attached evidence rules.
Use literal claims, qualifications, sources, and actions with no decorative crossing.

prohibited_substitutions: Do not replace evidence attachment with decorative numbered sections.
Do not let generic component-library cards become the identity system.
recognition_tests: Remove the logo and primary accent color; claim-to-evidence attachment should remain recognizable.
Generate a marketing page, dense review surface, and error state without repeating one layout.

refinement_passes.purpose: Ground the direction in inspected working materials and supplied project intent.
changes: Replaced generic editorial devices with evidence annotations derived from working papers.
Selected an attached evidence margin over a conventional report grid and a presentation-like sequence.

refinement_passes.purpose: Make the subject-specific signature visible in the concept.
changes: Allowed one proof block to cross the reading boundary.

refinement_passes.purpose: Review the direction for executive comprehension, evidence integrity, accessibility, and trust.
changes: Distinguished observed and inferred material through labels and color roles.
preserved: Evidence remains adjacent to the claim it qualifies.

refinement_passes.purpose: Quiet competing expression and protect reading rhythm.
changes: Limited the boundary crossing to one moment and kept typography, motion, imagery, and depth quiet.
preserved: The evidence margin remains the recognizable signature.

refinement_passes.purpose: Transform the organizing idea for narrow targets.
changes: Converted the persistent margin into an inline reveal immediately following its claim.

refinement_passes.purpose: Compare representative rendered output with the design contract.
unresolved: Representative wide and narrow artifacts have not yet been reviewed.

contextual_reviews.why_applicable: The audience must move quickly from a recommendation to the evidence and uncertainty that qualify it.
contextual_reviews.finding: A detached evidence panel would make qualification look optional and weaken the reading path.
contextual_reviews.design_response: Attach the evidence margin directly to each qualified claim and convert it to an immediate inline reveal on narrow targets.
contextual_reviews.verification: In wide and narrow reference compositions, each qualified claim remains immediately associated with its evidence state.

contextual_reviews.why_applicable: The direction presents observations, inferences, and recommendations with materially different certainty.
contextual_reviews.finding: Color alone would not reliably communicate evidence status or survive grayscale output.
contextual_reviews.design_response: Pair every evidence color role with a direct status label and preserve that label in non-color contexts.
preserved_behavior: Evidence adjacent to the claim it qualifies
contextual_reviews.verification: Evidence states remain distinguishable with color removed and are announced with equivalent text.

reference_compositions: Wide: recommendation field with persistent evidence margin and one boundary-crossing proof moment.
Narrow: linear brief with evidence disclosed immediately after each qualified claim.
uniqueness_checks: Removing the evidence margin would remove the identity, not merely decoration.
The palette, type roles, composition, and copy would change materially for an unrelated product.
